translations.web: He made chains in the inner sanctuary, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
translations.bsb: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He made a hundred pomegranates and fastened them into the chainwork.
translations.kjv: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
translations.asv: And he made chains in the oracle, and put them on the tops of the pillars; and he made a hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
